Saint-Gobain Innovation Hub India (SGI-I) is seeking highly motivated Agentic AI Engineers to develop and deploy next-generation AI solutions that accelerate scientific discovery, engineering innovation, manufacturing excellence, and knowledge discovery across Saint-Gobain's global R&D ecosystem.

This role goes beyond building AI prototypes. You will work closely with researchers, engineers, scientists, manufacturing experts, and global business stakeholders to design, develop, deploy, and scale enterprise-grade AI solutions that solve real-world scientific and engineering challenges.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering skills with hands-on expertise in Prompt Engineer, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Search, and enterprise AI platforms, while maintaining a strong focus on business impact, usability, and adoption.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop AI solutions for research, product innovation, and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Build Agentic AI applications for technical knowledge discovery, experiment planning, process optimization, troubleshooting, and decision support.

  • Build reusable AI platforms, APIs, and enterprise services for global R&D and manufacturing organizations.
  • Integrate AI solutions with enterprise data platforms, laboratory systems, simulation tools, and cloud ecosystems.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to identify and deliver high-impact AI solutions.
  • Ensure AI solutions are scalable, secure, explainable, and aligned with Responsible AI principles.

Required Skills

  • Strong Python programming skills with experience developing enterprise AI applications.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, Agentic AI, RAG, Prompt Engineering, LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar AI frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Computer Vision.
  • Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, or equivalent cloud AI platforms.
  • Experience with vector databases, semantic search, knowledge graphs, and AI search technologies.
  • Experience building REST APIs, FastAPI, microservices, and scalable AI applications.
  • Familiarity with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, MLOps, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, and CI/CD.
  • Exposure to engineering, manufacturing, or scientific data is preferred.

Education & Experience

Education (Mandatory)

  • M.E./M.Tech. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgy, Physics, Electronics, or a related engineering/scientific discipline.

Experience

  • 3 -5 years of experience in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or AI Engineering.
  • Experience developing AI solutions for industrial R&D, engineering, manufacturing, or scientific environments.
  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary research and engineering teams.

Preferred Profile

  • Experience working in industrial R&D organizations, innovation centers, or technology development teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve engineering or scientific problems using AI and Machine Learning.
  • Publications, patents, or technical contributions will be an added advantage.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills with a passion for applying AI to scientific discovery and engineering innovation.

Preferred Domain Experience

Candidates with AI experience in one or more of the following domains will be highly preferred:

Factory AI

  • Advanced Manufacturing
  • Process Engineering
  • Industrial Automation
  • Digital Engineering & Process Simulation

title: BU FP&A - Financial Analyst - CP&O
jobDescription:
This Business Unit FPA Analyst position is located in Bengaluru, India, and reports to the Team Lead, BU FPA Capability under the Controlling Practices and Operations (Finance COE) organization. The role supports Hitachi Energys global Business Units, Hubs (Regions), Global Product Groups (GPGs), Countries, and Operating Units, serving as a finance partner to business and finance stakeholders to drive financial performance, forecasting accuracy, reporting excellence, and operational insights.
What we see in you: A strong foundation in financial and cost accounting, supported by solid FPA and analytical skills. You are an effective communicator, passionate about learning and continuous improvement, and eager to apply insights and drive execution in a highly complex global manufacturing environment.
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform analysis of business performance versus Budget, Flash, Forecast, Latest Estimate, prior Quarter, and Prior Year.
  • Consolidate, challenge, and validate forecasts received from project, business, country, and factory stakeholders, ensuring consistency of assumptions, forecasts, and financial outlooks across the designated BU, Hub, or product group.
  • Support monthly forecasting, budgeting, and planning processes.
  • Monitor and analyze Order Backlog, Revenue, Gross Margin, EBIT, SGA, Headcount, Productivity, Working Capital, Cash Flow, and Capex.
  • Prepare monthly management reporting packs, KPI dashboards, executive presentations, and variance analysis.
  • Support month-end close activities. These include validating the accuracy, integrity, and completeness of financial actual KPIs in reporting tools Vs system reports, identifying, escalating, and resolving gaps, consolidating estimates from factories and countries at the Hub or product group level, preparing preliminary updates to stakeholders in a time-bound manner, including preparing and posting manual journal entries and intercompany postings.
  • Perform Balance sheet analysis proactively identify PL and Balance Sheet accounting impacts, contract assets and liabilities, inventory, and net working capital movements between different periods with the reasons for deviation and advise controllers for necessary action.
  • Analyze Cash Flow, Inventory, and Net Working Capital performance and provide insights
  • Support product, project, customer, factory, and business profitability analysis.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, commercial and wider finance teams.
  • Perform trend analysis, scenario modeling, and ad hoc financial analysis.
  • Support audits, controls, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Analyze overhead /labor under/over absorption, material standard cost variances, and identify root causes and corrective actions.
Knowledge and Skills
  • Strong financial accounting and revenue recognition methods (Point in time, Percentage of Completion, Time-based, etc.)
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with proactive, self-motivated, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good Microsoft Excel, financial modeling, and PowerPoint skills
  • Ability to use and leverage AI good AI literacy is a strong plus.
  • Effective communication presentation skills.
  • Good understanding of SAP S/4HANA is highly desired, including FICO, CO-PA, SD, PP, MM; highly desired.
  • Initiative-taking with a strong commitment to quality, adhering to strict deadlines
Experience:
2 to 4 yearsexperience in Financial Planning and Analysis, with a preferable manufacturing background. prior experience in controlling COE setup preferable
Education:
Bachelors degree in accounting with CMA/ CA / MBA Finance

title: Supply Chain Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Job Summary
The purpose of this role is practical application of data science in supply chain planning and inventory management to improve underlaying processes and deliver financial value.
To succeed in this role, you must have multidisciplinary skill set - proven experience in project management and SC planning, knowledge of planning systems (SAP APO/IBP, OM Partners or similar), SAP architecture (underlying tables, transactions) and strong technical and analytical skills.
In this creative role you will have unique opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders in the global organization working on various improvement initiatives, development of analytical tools, optimization models or supply chain simulations and you need to feel comfortable in each stage of this process (design, develop and deploy) to thrive and succeed.
You are self-starter with hands-on approach and continues improvement mindset working on your own initiative under moderate supervision. You know how to source and use data together with statistical methods and technology to improve processes. It is important you have theoretical knowledge but more important you understand how to use it in practice to add value.
Your nearest assignments will focus on portfolio segmentation, product life cycle management, development of replenishment strategies and inventory optimization within distribution network. All contributing to development of planning tool supporting decision making process for planning teams.
Qualifications
  • Degree in Supply Chain Management or APICS CPIM certification and 5-7+ years experience in Global Supply Chain and Inventory Management essential (multi-site, multi-region),
  • Degree or certification in Data Science desirable,
  • Formal Project Management and problem-solving training desirable, e.g., Six Sigma, Lean.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to select and work with appropriate analytical tools and software (Excel, PBI, relevant libraries in R and Python or SQL) and build ETL pipelines,
  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools, such as Codex, to accelerate data analysis, code development, documentation, troubleshooting, and creation of analytical tools while applying appropriate validation and governance,
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, data quality, business relevance, bias, and operational feasibility before applying them to supply chain planning, inventory optimization, or decision-support processes,
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and visualize findings,
  • Demonstrated ability to wrangle, cleanse and model data from various sources (SAP, .csv, .xlsx, .txt, .parquet, .rds, data lake etc.),
  • Proficient in Excel and Power BI (Power Query/M, DAX, relational database model, data visualization); Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification is a plus,
  • Knowledge of SQL and R/Python highly desirable,
  • Experience working with data warehouse/data lake desirable (experience with Snowflake a plus),
  • Knowledge of Statistics and Machine Learning or strong willingness to quickly develop in this area.
Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and to prioritise actions for maximum impact.
Ability to develop and deploy short-term tools and reporting capabilities (with quantified accuracy and precision) essential.
Solid written and verbal communication skills, experience in a matrix environment desirable.
Environmental Working Conditions and Physical Effort
Typically works in an office environment with adequate lighting and ventilation and a normal range of temperature and noise level.
Work assignments are diversified. Examples of past precedent are used to resolve work problems.
Most aspects of work are timebound and fit into a standard reporting cycle based on the monthly financial reporting calendar. There is an ongoing requirement to work to deadlines and to manage competing priorities.
Minimal physical effort is required. Work is mostly sedentary but does require walking, standing, bending, reaching, lifting or carrying objects that typically weigh less than 10 lbs.

  • Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/SystemVerilog and/or VHDL required.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates required (not incidental exposure).
  • Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10M to 1.6T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs.
  • Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products.
  • Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (VoIP, IPTV).
  • Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques.
  • Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches.
  • Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary.
  • Version control experience using Git or similar tools.
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world.
  • Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.
Nice to have
  • Patents or published work in FPGA architecture, high-speed digital design, or DSP.
  • Experience defining test strategies for multi-Gbps compliance testing (particularly relevant for TM product development).
  • General purpose microprocessor and DSP systems, PCIe, high-speed digital board design, PLL design, and analog signal conditioning experience.
  • Simulation experience using Siemens Questa, Aldec Riviera, or similar tools.
  • Contribution to or deep familiarity with open verification methodologies (e.g., cocotb, UVM community contributions).
  • Utilization of generative AI tools to assist in concept and implementation of FPGA designs.

title: Senior Product Manager
jobDescription:
Job Title : Senior Product Manager

Location : Bangalore; (Full Time, Onsite)

About Locus

Battle-tested in 350+ deployments across 30+ countries, Locus is an agentic Transportation Management System for all-mile, all-channel, trusted by enterprises like Unilever, Nestl , and Siam Makro.

The platform unifies orders, capacity, and carrier networks into one living plan, aligning planning, execution, and settlement so promises become proof. AI co-pilots with guardrails surface risk early and recommend the next best move to protect SLAs and reduce empty miles.

In 2025, Locus joined the Ingka Group (IKEA Retail) family, marking a major milestone in our journey. Backed by the scale and strength of IKEA, we continue to operate independently while accelerating our mission to make global supply chains faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

Our Journey and Impact

Since 2015, Locus has been on a mission to make logistics decision-making intelligent, sustainable, and real-world ready. Our platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30 + countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance. With the strength of the IKEA ecosystem behind us, we re scaling that impact even further.

Our Global Footprint

Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, Locus brings together 170 + engineers, designers, and problem-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.

Traits We Value

We look for people who are:

  • Global in mindset : curious about diverse markets and ideas.

  • Unrelenting in drive : energized by complex challenges.

  • Intelligent in approach : analytical, creative, and thoughtful.

  • Dynamic in execution : adaptive and decisive in fast-moving contexts.

  • Exact in craft : detail-oriented and committed to excellence.

About the role

Locus is rebuilding last-mile delivery as a multi-tenant SaaS platform. The DiSCO Mobile App is the driver-facing surface - used by drivers, 2-person crews, and hub-ops staff across enterprise tenants (IKEA, Giant Tiger, and the long tail of Locus customers).

The Senior PM will own one or more product modules end-to-end - Hub Depot Operations, Execution at Customer Stop, Returns Reverse Logistics, Multi-Trip Shifts, or Workforce Auth - from scoping with domain PMs, through workflow design with UX, to release readiness with the engineering pod and customer-onboarding teams.

The role partners with the Principal PM on overall app vision and runs its modules independently.


What youll do

  • Own a slice of the mobile app: scope it, write the spec, drive design partnership, shepherd it through engineering, land it in tenant rollouts.

  • Author mobile workflow specs (Delivery / Pickup / Hub Depot / Returns) and the matching epic + story tickets in Jira.

  • Coordinate with domain PMs (Execution, Hub Ops, Workforce, Order Management) to translate entity specs and design decisions into driver-facing scenarios.

  • Partner with UX on gap closure and with the mobile engineering pod on sequencing and delivery.

  • Own one or more enterprise tenant rollouts - translating customer requirements into product changes vs. tenant config, and holding the line on what is product-grade vs. one-off.

  • Uphold platform defaults: client-agnostic architecture, point-of-use permissions, plain-language UX, no over-engineered enterprise theatre.

What were looking for

  • 6+ years in product management, including 3+ years on enterprise SaaS or platform products. Mobile app PM experience is a strong plus.

  • Shipped in domain-heavy, multi-team environments - comfortable reading entity specs, sequence diagrams, and engineering RFCs, not just user stories.

  • Spec author. Can write a 3,000-word workflow doc that engineering, design, and customer success can all build from.

  • Strong opinions about driver / operator UX - has shipped for low-context, high-pressure mobile users (delivery, field service, frontline ops, warehousing).

  • Jira-as-source-of-truth discipline: every scope decision is a ticket, every blocker is a link, every spec gap is a child story.

  • Bias toward plain language, concrete examples, and decision-by-tradeoff over decision-by-framework.

Nice to have

  • Logistics / last-mile / supply-chain domain background.

  • Multi-tenant SaaS scoping experience (whats product vs. whats tenant config).

  • Comfort with domain-driven teams (DDD, event sourcing, entity-first specs


What We Offer

Join Locus and become part of a visionary team that is redefining logistics through innovation and smart distribution. We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative environment where your expertise will drive both your growth and that of the organization.

Locus is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.

jobDescription:
>

Technical Solutions Lead, Nature-Based Carbon

Location: Gurgaon, India

Type: Full-Time

Experience: 4-10 years

Tags: Nature Based Solutions Regenerative Agriculture Agroforestry Arr Afforestation Soil Carbon Agronomy Mrv Remote Sensing Carbon Methodology Due Diligence Technical Writing Additionality Permanence Smallholder Farming Contract Farming Agri Business Sustainable Sourcing Climate Tech Voluntary Carbon Market

About Varaha

Varaha is the largest carbon removal developer in Asia, working with more than 200,000 smallholder farmers. Trusted by brands like Google and Microsoft, we combine an exceptional team with deeply impactful work. Through regenerative agriculture, afforestation, and biochar, our projects remove carbon while simultaneously restoring soils, protecting biodiversity, and improving livelihoods far beyond our project boundaries. We are a profitable, rapidly growing company backed by premier global private equity and top-tier venture capital. Our roots are in India, and our impact is global.

The Opportunity

Varaha runs the largest smallholder soil carbon project in the world and has closed the largest regenerative agriculture deals in the market. Behind that sits a measurement stack built on multiple bio-geo-chemical models, remote sensing, and machine learning, calibrated against physical soil samples from the field by a world-class science team. Buyers, auditors, and funders all want the same thing from it: a clear, sourced account of what we measured and why it holds.

You are the commercial teams technical authority on regenerative agriculture and afforestation, and the person who turns several hundred thousand hectares of fieldwork into documents a Chief Sustainability Officer can act on. Regenerative agriculture comes first. Afforestation and reforestation follow.

We are deliberately open on background. Agronomists from agri-conglomerates, people who have run contract farming or sustainable sourcing programmes at scale, agri-input and agri-tech technical leads, remote sensing specialists, and programme leads who have delivered smallholder work across large geographies all fit. What matters is that you have stood in a field, know what the data from it can and cannot support, and write clearly.

Reporting To: CCO

Key Responsibilities

  • Answer buyer and auditor diligence. Sort what you can answer now from what needs expert input, then produce the response with sources, assumptions, and the limits of the claim stated.

  • Sit in on sales calls. You explain the measurement, the project, and the impact directly to the client. The project team stays on the projects.

  • Run our side of ratings and verification. Prepare submissions, handle analyst and auditor questions, and push back with evidence where a finding is wrong.

  • Build the answer library so the same question is never answered from scratch twice and our language stays consistent across proposals, contracts, and project documents.

  • Create what is missing. Method summaries, appendices, diagrams, data summaries, and operating procedures, wherever a gap is holding up a deal.

  • Turn data into claims. Read agronomy datasets and remote sensing outputs and convert them into short statements we can defend in front of a buyer.

  • Cover the impact side. Farmer and community outcomes weigh as heavily with buyers as the carbon itself. You build the evidence base on incomes, livelihoods, and co-benefits across 200,000+ smallholders, work with what the field data supports when it is limited, and state where it is thin.

  • Guide the commercial team on presenting technical content accurately, and train them to handle the straightforward questions themselves.

Qualifications

  • 4-10 years working on agriculture, agroforestry, or land use, ideally involving smallholder farmers in Asia or Africa.

  • Technical writing that has survived outside scrutiny. Project documents, monitoring reports, diligence responses, or funding proposals. Please send samples.

  • A working grasp of the fundamentals that decide whether a carbon project is credible: baselines, additionality, permanence, leakage, and buffer pools. If you know these from an adjacent field, say so and we will look at it.

  • Comfort with soil carbon or biomass measurement, sampling design, and the monitoring that sits around it.

  • Ability to work with agronomy data and remote sensing outputs directly.

  • Skilled at using AI tools to digest dense material and produce strong first drafts fast.

  • Written English at a standard that holds in front of international buyers.

  • Commercial judgement. Benefits, costs, and risks presented without inflation.

  • Structured habits: clean intake, targeted questions to experts, careful citation, and documents you can find again.

Preferred

  • Experience with any carbon standard, including direct auditor interaction. Not required.

  • Grant or concessional funding proposals with results you can point to.

  • Writing operating procedures for field protocols and quality control.

  • Confident enough on a call to lead a session with a US or European buyer alone.

Why This Role Matters

Nature-based carbon has a credibility problem across the industry, and much of it comes down to how the work is explained. Varahas measurement is among the strongest in the sector. Making that legible to buyers and funders moves capital toward 200,000 smallholder land stewards who are already doing the work.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity through ESOPs.

  • The first seat in this function. You define how it works.

  • Direct exposure to the largest corporate carbon buyers in the world.

  • Support for learning and professional development.

  • A culture of undogmatic, unbureaucratic creativity and collaboration.

title: Computational Biology Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Role Summary
The AIN-based Computational Biology Data Scientist will design, implement, and advance advanced analytical and AI-driven frameworks to enable translational and reverse-translational insights from clinical trial data across Amgens global development portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of computational biology, advanced statistics, and modern machine learning, with a strong emphasis on predictive and prognostic biomarker modeling, multi-omic data integration, and next-generation AI-enabled analytical platforms.
The successful candidate will contribute intellectually and technically to Amgens precision medicine strategy by developing rigorous, scalable, and scientifically interpretable models that link molecular, cellular, and clinical phenotypes to disease stratification, efficacy, safety, and adverse event outcomes. This role requires demonstrated depthnot familiarityin applied modeling, multi-omic analytics, and AI systems, with evidence of impact through peer-reviewed publications, production-grade codebases, or verifiable industry experience.
Key Responsibilities
Advanced Modeling Translational Analytics
  • Design and implement predictive and prognostic biomarker models using clinical trial and biomarker data, including response, resistance, disease stratification, and adverse event endpoints.
  • Develop and apply multi-omic integration frameworks (e.g., factor models, MOFA-style latent variable approaches, matrix factorization, graph-based methods) to jointly analyze genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, epigenomics, imaging, and clinical covariates.
  • Apply advanced statistical methodologies relevant to clinical development, including longitudinal and mixed-effects models, survival analysis, missing data and imputation strategies, confounder adjustment, and model interpretability.
  • Contribute to study-level and cross-program analyses that inform mechanism of action, patient selection strategies, and development decisions.
Machine Learning, AI Emerging Capabilities
  • Build and evaluate machine learning, deep learning and causal inference models applied to biological and clinical data, with a clear understanding of model assumptions, limitations, and validation in regulated environments.
  • Develop or meaningfully contribute to AI-enabled analytical systems, including:
    • Foundation and large language modelbased approaches (e.g., GPT-class models) for scientific workflows
    • Generative models for representation learning, hypothesis generation, or simulation
    • Agentic AI systems (assistive, conversational, automated, predictive, or sentinel) to support analysis, decision-making, or platform capabilities
  • Partner with platform and engineering teams to ensure analytical methods are reproducible, scalable, and production-ready.
Scientific Rigor, Collaboration Communication
  • Translate biological and clinical questions into well-defined analytical strategies and clearly articulate modeling choices, assumptions, and uncertainties.
  • Collaborate closely with biomarker scientists, clinicians, biostatisticians, and data engineers across global teams and time zones.
  • Communicate complex analytical results and their implications effectively through technical documentation, presentations, and cross-functional forums.
  • Operate with scientific independence while proactively seeking alignment and clarification in a highly matrixed, global development environment.
Basic Qualifications
  • Doctorate degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline with 12 years of relevant experience
    OR
  • Masters degree in a quantitative discipline with 5 years of relevant experience
  • 6+ years of experience in an industry setting
Preferred Qualifications
Candidates should provide verifiable evidence for most of the following:
Quantitative Computational Depth
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience developing statistical or machine learning models for complex, multi-modal biomedical or clinical datasets, evidenced by:
    • Peer-reviewed publications in reputable journals, and/or
    • Public or internal GitHub repositories with substantive analytical or modeling contributions, and/or
    • Clearly documented industry experience supporting clinical or translational programs.
  • Proven expertise in Python and R for scientific computing and modeling, including the development of reusable, well-documented analytical code.
  • Experience with modern ML/DL libraries and frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, tidymodels), with an understanding of when such methods are appropriate given clinical context.
Translational Clinical Relevance
  • Demonstrated understanding of drug development and clinical trial data, including biomarker strategies, endpoint definitions, and translational study design.
  • Experience working with real-world clinical or biomarker data, including data QC, preprocessing, feature engineering, integration, modeling, and interpretation.
  • Familiarity with common clinical biomarker modalities and data types (e.g., NGS, transcriptomics, proteomics, imaging, immunoassays).
AI, Innovation Platform Mindset
  • Direct experience applying or extending generative AI, foundation models, or agentic systems for scientific, analytical, or decision-support use cases.
  • Ability to critically evaluate new methods and technologies and assess their suitability for regulated, high-impact biomedical applications.
Professional Global Operating Skills
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to explain complex quantitative work to diverse audiences.
  • Experience working with global teams and stakeholders across time zones; willingness to operate flexibly to support global programs.
  • Demonstrated intellectual humility, adaptability, curiosity, and the ability to pivot analytical approaches as program needs evolve.
  • Strong sense of ownership, scientific judgment, and accountability in complex, interdisciplinary projects.
What Will Distinguish Top Candidates
  • Clear evidence of end-to-end ownership of analytical work that influenced scientific or development decisions.
  • Depth in framework-building, not just model application.
  • A demonstrated ability to balance methodological sophistication with biological and clinical relevance.
  • Prior experience in large, global biotech or pharmaceutical organizations is strongly preferred.
